Senior Software Engineer, AI Security

About the team
We protect enterprises from risky users and risky AI agents.

Responsibilities
- Build risk detection and scoring for users and AI agents at enterprise scale.
- Enforce adaptive access policies (for example Conditional Access) that tighten as risk rises.
- Process historical activity to bootstrap risk models for new customers.
- Correlate signals across security products into investigations.
- Own features end to end from design through launch.

Required
- Experience with C#/.NET or Java on Azure.
- Experience with Microsoft security products such as Entra, Purview, Defender or Sentinel.
- Experience with data loss prevention or insider risk.

Preferred
- Experience with Rust.
- Experience with Okta or SAML-based identity.
